description: Enum class defining various statuses for ShareAccount in the Fineract project, including methods for status checks and conversion from integer values.

classes.name: ShareAccountStatusType
classes.description: Enumeration representing different states of a ShareAccount, such as INVALID, SUBMITTED_AND_PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, ACTIVE, REJECTED, and CLOSED, with utility methods for status evaluation.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding ShareAccountStatusType enum value.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current status matches a given state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the status.

methods.name: isSubmittedAndPendingApproval
methods.description: Checks if the status is SUBMITTED_AND_PENDING_APPROVAL.

methods.name: isApproved
methods.description: Checks if the status is APPROVED.

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Checks if the status is REJECTED.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the status is ACTIVE.

methods.name: isActiveOrAwaitingApprovalOrDisbursal
methods.description: Checks if the status is either approved, submitted and pending approval, or active.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the status is CLOSED or rejected.
